summary: PASS on all six acceptance lines of LEGION-80 spec v9, at PR head c4f58e44aaf58259bff3dba1f11b8be2dff0780c (Tests run 34814491558 green). Every implementer proof was re-run independently on the tagged build mise x github:sjawhar/oh-my-pi@18.1.21-sami.20260914-060332 -- omp against a fresh throwaway postgres:16 (127.0.0.1:55481, container legion-80-pg-test, cwd /tmp/legion-80-test — none of the implementer's port, container, or cwd), with LEGION_*/DISPATCH_* scrubbed and OMP_PROFILE=legion: one row per SQL session, --resume on the row path restores the code word, the unset control writes a .jsonl with no storage line and leaves the row count alone, all five refusals name the variable and path and never the connection string, legion probe-image prints the token on the new pin and the predates message on the old one, the subagent test is red-green, the docs section matches the measured outputs, and the hook citations open at the pinned tag. Beyond the plan: the same round trip and the closed-port refusal hold on `omp --mode rpc`, the daemon's actual launch mode. No smoke rig, daemon, bus, or tmux server was started (standing order 2026-09-13 19:00Z); the one throwaway Postgres container ran in this process and was removed. The fork diff review (report only) found one seam, one resolver, 24 mechanical default swaps, no duplicated resolver/default logic, no Legion names; one uniformity-only observation on gc-cli.ts for the reviewer.

implementerProof.how: Re-ran each of the four proofs in .legion/implement.json (Acceptance 3, 4, 6, 2) from this tester's own process on a different Postgres container (legion-80-pg-test, 127.0.0.1:55481), cwd (/tmp/legion-80-test), and password, on the same tagged build, and read the assistant text from the omp_session_files row rather than stdout as the implementer advised. Every observation reproduced: exactly one row per SQL session with the path shape <sessions root>/-tmp-legion-80-test/<timestamp>_<id>.jsonl, resume answering PINEAPPLE with the row growing (6839 → 11129 bytes), the unset control writing a .jsonl with the row count unchanged and no storage line, the three refusal strings byte-identical apart from the path, probe-image OK with session-storage=probed on the new pin and the predates message with exit 1 on the old, and 61/61 on legion.test.ts with the named test failing when the process-local check is disabled. The implementer's mise where, omp --version, and the fork blob-sha release verification were taken as read; the release tag content was cross-checked by reading commit f3278eeda197 (the tag's tip) through the GitHub API.

forkDiffReview.read: commit f3278eeda197ba1e241c2800b8a0baf21ef2dc19 on sjawhar/oh-my-pi (the tag's tip; the compare e4dd2ec3...f3278eed spans 107 commits because the operator rebased onto 18.1.21, so the single commit is the fork change) via `legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/oh-my-pi/commits/<sha>`: +367/-34 over 16 files
forkDiffReview.shape: one resolver (session-storage-config.ts: env → setting → file → Bun.SQL → SqlSessionStorage.create, five refusals), one seam (session-storage.ts: defaultSessionStorage()/setDefaultSessionStorage()), 24 mechanical `new FileSessionStorage()` → `defaultSessionStorage()` default swaps (session-manager 10, session-listing 5, session-loader 3, gc-cli 2, selector-controller 2, session-picker 1, startup-composer 1), main.ts installs the storage inside the existing session-resolution try and SessionStorageConfigError shares SessionResolutionError's stderr+exit(1) branch (hint printed only for the latter), 9 schema lines beside auth.broker.*, 8 unit tests (file default; sql round trip through the seam with nothing on disk; env overrides settings; both-names, missing, blank, unknown-value, and closed-port refusals), one changelog line, docs mirrors in settings.md, environment-variables.md, session.md
forkDiffReview.dryFindings: None that duplicate resolver or default logic. The auth-broker precedent (packages/ai/src/auth-broker/discover.ts) reads config.yml as YAML directly because packages/ai cannot import coding-agent's Settings, so nothing there was reusable; the resolver's env-then-setting precedence is the smallest expression of it. FileSessionStorage has no instance fields (only #discardTemp/#replaceSessionFileAfterEpermSync methods), so the seam's shared instance is safe. The schema comment's 'Hidden from the UI; populate via env vars or hand-edited config.yml' is the auth.broker.* block's own wording; the schema has no per-setting hidden flag (hidden? belongs to ModelTagDef), so no flag was omitted.
observations: gc-cli.ts: the two swaps are uniformity only — `omp gc` is a subcommand that never reaches runRootCommand's resolver, so its storage is always the file one (docs/session.md 'Selecting the storage' says so). Not a defect; the reviewer may weigh it against 'nothing beyond making the existing storage selectable'.
Zero added lines contain legion, envoy, secretsd, dispatch://, or knives (the commit's Omp-Session trailer is the extension's automatic attribution).

The resolver runs before RPC mode too: `omp --mode rpc` with the closed-port file refuses with the same message and exit 1, and a prompt over the RPC protocol (negotiate_protocol → prompt) writes a row and `--mode rpc --resume=<row path>` restores it — LEGION-81's daemon relaunch path is covered by the fork change as shipped, not only the -p form the plan's commands use.

In `-p` mode the assistant's own text is not on stdout on this build (only the profile plugin's 'No pending work…' line is); the assistant text was read from the row's content, as the implementer's forTester note says.
`shutdown` is not an OMP RPC command on this build (`Unknown command: shutdown`); the daemon's shutdown frame is the worker-shim's, so the omp processes here ended on stdin EOF with exit 0.
documentationFeedback: docs/kubernetes.md Session store matches every measured output; nothing to change.
